atoms.b: Once the ((++rocket plane)) had reached the Moon on the 20th July, Neil Armstrong and Buzz Aldrin went into a small pod that could land safely on the Moon’s surface.
((++Michael_Collins John_Kennedy)) stayed behind in the main rocket to control the landing of the smaller pod, called the Eagle.

instruction.text: Drag the Eagle to the Moon.

feedback.finish: When they reached the Moon, Armstrong said “The Eagle has landed” to let people know that they had successfully arrived.
Neil Armstrong was the first human to walk on the Moon. Aldrin and Armstrong spent 21 hours and 36 minutes on the Moon conducting experiments, taking photographs and exploring.

atoms.a: That’s one small step for man, ...
atoms.sound: That’s one small step for man, one giant leap for mankind.

feedback.finish: 600 million people watched the Moon landing on television and listened to Neil Armstrong’s famous saying.

instruction.text: Build the picture of the Moon.

feedback.finish: Before successfully returning to Earth, the astronauts put the flag of the USA on the Moon to show that they had won the Space Race.
